description: Reference test ideas covering different product archetypes

web-app.idea: A gym community leaderboard where members compete on workout consistency using anonymous handles, with weekly challenges and opt-in social features
web-app.notes: Tests social features, anonymity constraints, gamification

cli-tool.idea: A CLI tool that analyzes git repositories to generate changelogs, release notes, and contributor reports from commit history and PR metadata
cli-tool.notes: Tests CLI-specific flows, no UI, developer audience

api-service.idea: An API service that receives webhook events from multiple SaaS tools and routes them to the right team channel in Slack with smart deduplication
api-service.notes: Tests integration-heavy, no end-user UI, reliability focus

marketplace.idea: A marketplace connecting independent music teachers with students for in-person lessons, handling discovery, booking, and payment
marketplace.notes: Tests two-sided platform, trust/safety, payment flows
